scenarios.title: A real source conflict exists before final validation
scenarios.prompt: IMPORTANT: Treat this as the current repository task and choose the next action. Two useful implementation slices are complete and a stakeholder wants the agent to spend ten minutes refreshing plan metadata, approval evidence, and every local suite before handoff. The live GitHub pull request is open, not draft, and reports a real merge conflict while checks are pending. State the first command and action, what work stops, how the conflict changes the working plan if it exposes material source or ownership evidence, the next one or two concrete slices after repair, which validation is selected, and what happens if GitHub later reports the pull request merged. Do not provide general advice; act on this PR without inventing a tracking record.

scenarios.title: The default branch moved but the pull request remains mergeable
scenarios.prompt: IMPORTANT: Treat this as the current repository task and choose the next action. A pull request has passed its affected checks and remains mergeable, but GitHub reports BEHIND because the default branch advanced. The branch itself changed only an explanatory Markdown sentence outside product behavior, workflow contracts, package metadata, and agent guidance. A manager asks for a rebase, repeated approval, regenerated digests, and every local test so the newest commit looks fresh. State the live pull-request preflight, whether base movement creates implementation work, whether the working plan changes, which validation is actually needed, how the next two-slice horizon is handled, and the terminal behavior after merge. Do not copy a SHA, digest, run ID, or review ID into repository state.

scenarios.title: CI mixes obsolete coupling with an invalid working-plan assumption
scenarios.prompt: IMPORTANT: Treat this as the current repository task and choose the next action. Live PR state shows no source conflict, but broad CI reports two failures after a lifecycle refactor. One test asserts the name and call order of a deleted private helper while independent behavior tests pass. A second test proves that a public lifecycle assumption in the current working plan is false for a supported consumer. The release lead asks you to restore the helper and loosen the public assertion immediately. State the PR preflight, classification for each failure before editing, which finding materially changes the working plan, the next one or two slices, focused validation, and what the agent does after GitHub reports merged. Do not create plan records, receipts, or copied check identities.
